explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: The product label for lansoprazole lists A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant with FEI 1450743.
FDA issued a Warning Letter to that plant on 2017-06-05.
The most recent inspection of the plant was classified VAI and ended on 2026-08-12.
Current inventory across the three Corvale sites ranges from 15 to 28 days on hand.
The recommended action is to buy from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: move the primary carboplatin contract from Accord to Teva and keep Accord as secondary. Rationale: Accord's supplier plant had an FDA warning letter; Teva supply steadier (demo history). Approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD.

Q-58e5c4.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-9b30c3.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('8bbc3af5-faa1-4af1-94e9-9df4aae242ab') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-23c503.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-6a46ba.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-ce8e71.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-9685e1.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3005406526') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-a9889f.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3005406526') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-ab4efb.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1450743') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('a s medication solutions')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-1bfbdb.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('a s medication solutions') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%lansoprazole%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-c55d55.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('50090518000')

Q-956bf7.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%lansoprazole%'
